title: Twenty Gaza students due to leave for Ireland after winning visa battle
summary_full: Group’s evacuation follows campaign to overturn decision to deny visas to more than 60 students from territoryTwenty students from Gaza are to travel to Ireland to take up scholarships after winning a battle for visas that undercut the Irish government’s reputation as a champion of Palestinians.The group is due to leave the territory on Monday under strict Israeli controls and travel via Jordan to Dublin to take up places at Irish universities. Another group is expected to follow next month. Continue reading...
